tags: fusion bronze half-round knob with bronze Oval rose

text.description_html:
Fusion 07-C6, Bronze Half Round Knob With Bronze Oval Rose

This simple Half-Round Knob paired with the classically styled Oval Rose allows it to seamlessly blend into any decor. Made out of sandcast bronze, this knobset is available in dark bronze, medium bronze, and antique pewter finishes--all of which emphasize the rustic beauty of the sandcast bronze material from which this door knob has been carefully crafted. It is available in either a 2-3/8 inch or a 2-3/4 inch backset; and will adjust to door thicknesses from 1-1/4 inches to 2 inches.

Also Available: More Rose Choices

Sandcasting is a process for casting metal in sand molds. The mold is made by packing the sand around a pattern. Molten Bronze is then poured into a mold cavity formed out of sand. Each sand mold is used only once. The sand is then recycled for the next piece.

Features for the Fusion 07 Half Round Knob With C6 Bronze Oval Rose:

  • True Bronze Product (Sandcast and Lost Wax) with over 90% Copper Content
  • Solid Brass/Bronze Construction
  • Cycle Tested to ANSI Standards
  • Exclusive Fusion knob spring assembly for lifetime performance
  • Reversible Latchbolt in matching/coordinating finish
  • Easy assembly with alignment block and rose posts

Specifications for Rustic Door Knob Fusion 07:

  • Knob Diameter: 2-3/8"
  • Knob Projection: 2-3/8"
  • Rose Length: 4-1/2"
  • Rose Width: 3"
  • Rose Projection: 1/2”
  • Door Thickness: 1-1/4" to 2"
  • Backsets: Either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Material: Solid Brass or Bronze
  • Standard Latch Rotation is 40 Degrees.
  • Square corner latches and strike plates
  • Lifetime Limited Warranty on workmanship, materials, and operation.
  • One Year Finish Warranty.

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: Non-functional pull to match trim on one side of the door. Just for looks, it does not latch and does not lock.
  • Dummy Set: Non-functional pull to match trim on both sides of the door. Just for looks, it does not latch and does not lock.
  • Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking.
  • Privacy (Bedroom or Bathroom): For doors that could need locking.
